THE WOMAN IN ROOM 309

WARNING: STRICTLY FOR MATURE READERS AGED 18 AND OVER.

This novel contains explicit sexual themes, strong language, psychological manipulation and desires that respectable society prefers to discuss behind closed doors.

Rose is brilliant, ambitious and still discovering the world.

Scarlett is fearless, adventurous and entirely unapologetic about the pleasures she pursues.

Victoria is wealthy, powerful and dangerously intelligent. She knows exactly what desire can buy, what obsession can destroy, and why some secrets are worth keeping.

It is a story about the things people crave, the boundaries they cross and the truths they dare not confess.

You were warned about the contents.

Nobody said you had to resist.
